messages:
Taylor: quick alert 1: canary promo blocked for the 11:00 UTC window. deploy-bot failed the package-extract step with mixed-layer content on a subset of runners.
Ivy: saw same on eu-north-1 and us-east-1. runner logs: "error: chunk mismatch (expected chunk 4 length 524288, got 131072)". registry checksum still equals builder output.
DeployBot: Automated Alert  promotion auto-hold
  promo-id: 8117
  failed-job: package-extract
  sample-runner: eu-north-1-runner-3
infra-bot: Observability: object-store upload throttle spikes and 5xx retries between 4311223200-4311223310. Multiple multipart shards reported delayed commits; origin served short ranges.
ops: this reads like upload-throttle caused chunk drift where some ranges got partially reassembled. builder reported success because the final commit returned 200, but some edge reads saw stale or partial ranges.
Taylor: options: (1) pin to prior verified artifact (fast, keeps window) (2) force reupload exact blobs from builder host (fast but risk copying bad file) (3) rebuild+upload fresh artifact (safe, may miss window).
Ivy: I'm +1 for pin-old, run acceptance on the pinned artifact, and open infra ticket to investigate throttle->commit race. We need to avoid silent success during multipart finalization.
release-manager: agree. pin to last-good sha256:7c9d... and note in release notes. schedule a rebuild+full reverify once infra confirms stable.
QA-bot: running acceptance on pinned artifact (sha256:7c9d...) across affected runners now. Will post result.
ops: prepping manual-promote PR and attaching blob-verify steps. Command draft: `/deploybot manual-promote PR-1304 lock-window 45m pin sha256:7c9d...`
DeployBot: Manual promote request created: PR-1304; status: awaiting approval.
infra-bot: Update: object-store throttle alleviated at 4311223348; no new 5xxs in last 90s. Creating infra ticket INF-1982 for multipart commit visibility and edge reassembly telemetry.
QA-bot: acceptance on pinned artifact -> PASS on eu-north-1 and us-east-1. No extract errors observed.
release-manager: approved manual promote. execute PR-1304 and add this short note to release_notes/changelog.md: "Canary held and pinned to sha256:7c9d... due to chunk/commit drift observed during artifact extract on some runners; rebuild+reupload scheduled (INF-1982)."
Taylor: thanks team. keeping window locked for 45m while rebuild is queued and INF-1982 is triaged. If ops completes a verified reupload within window we can unpin and reattempt full promo. :thumbsup:
